opening.argument: The video walks viewers through finding Facebook advertising support, showing the help area and a support-chat form as part of that process. The speaker presents it as a tutorial on reaching live chat, with a concrete instruction to use the help icon. The visible support form concerns contact and advertising-account information, consistent with the stated aim of addressing ad-account problems. The subscription request is ordinary audience engagement, not a condition for receiving help. Nothing described asks viewers to pay or submit information to the presenter, and the walkthrough makes no deceptive promise or claim that an account problem will be resolved. Its observable purpose is to demonstrate a support route.
